latest.name: CATalyst v1.2.23
release_notes: Improved Debug Bundle privacy before testers share support logs.
Redacts wallet addresses, Sage fingerprints, RPC/TLS paths, API tokens, cookies, passwords, seed/private-key labels, and local user-folder paths from bundled log tails and snapshots.
Updated the Logs tab help text so testers know what the bundle excludes or redacts.
